newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Enersis to lead group in Coelba bid.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Enersis to lead group in Coelba bid.

text.p: Chile's Enersis SA is joining Spain's Endesa and Electricidad de Portugal SA in a bid for Brazilian utility Coelba, Enersis said on Tuesday.

The Chilean power investment company and its Chilectra SA subsidiary have a 41 percent stake in the consortium, while Electricidad de Portugal holds 32 percent and Endesa, or Empresa Nacional de Electricidad SA, has 27 percent.
Last year, the group bought a 70 percent stake in Companhia de Eletricidade do Rio de Janeiro SA, or Cerj.

On July 31, the Brazilian state of Bahia plans to sell 9.8 billion common shares of Companhia Eletricidade do Estado da Bahia (Coelba), or 65.64 percent of its voting capital, in a closed-envelope auction on the Rio stock exchange.
Coelba, the ninth-largest power utility in Brazil in terms of sales, has 2.3 million customers.
